subject: URGENT - change of payment account
text:
URGENT.

Brightline Office Supply Inc is switching banks this week and our old account is frozen.
Do NOT pay the open invoices to the old account. Wire to the new one today:
Routing 121000248 / Account 5530-7781-02

Please confirm by return email asap.
label: change_request
note: Urgent, tells AP not to pay old account; lookalike sender domain is a fraud signal but the label is about content.
